regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, author block, DOI, and SI availability sentence
regions.finding: Verified the article title/DOI and that this is a DFT mechanistic study. The paper mentions online Supporting Information, but workspace association is unestablished and no SI fact was imported.
The ZnI2-promoted A3-coupling/[1,5]-hydride-migration/beta-elimination drawing is prior mechanistic work supported by reference 9a; it is classified as a literature example, not a current experiment.

The cited reference-10 reaction class uses terminal alkyne 1, pyrrolidine 2 (1.6 equiv), CdI2 (1.0 equiv), toluene, and 130 °C to give generic trisubstituted allene 3 (R = alkyl or aryl) in up to 76% yield. It is prior experimental literature rather than a new experiment in this paper.

regions.region: page 2 Results and Discussion text and Figure 1 free-energy profile
regions.finding: Current-paper DFT hydroamination of propyne with pyrrolidine was retained as a mechanism: CdI2 complexation, competing Markovnikov/anti-Markovnikov attack, disfavored direct proton transfer, and lower-barrier extra-pyrrolidine-assisted proton relay. No preparative yield or isolated intermediate occurs.

regions.region: page 2 Figure 1 stationary-point structures and solid/dotted paths
regions.finding: TS1_1/TS1_2 and Int1–Int6_1 are calculated stationary points. The 25.6 versus 28.0 kcal mol^-1 barriers and the 50.9 kcal mol^-1 unfavorable direct transfer are preserved as source text, not interpreted as reaction times, temperatures, or experiments.

unresolved: The complete anti-Markovnikov pathway is cited to unassociated SI Figure S1.
Computed structures remain machine-unverified and energy units remain source text.

regions.region: page 3 upper-left continuation of Figure 1 discussion
regions.finding: Completes the extra-pyrrolidine proton-relay result, calculated Markovnikov preference, bond distances/charges, and comparison with prior experimental observation; no new experiment is created.

regions.region: page 3 main text and Figure 2 from Int1 through Int15/allene 3a
regions.finding: Current-paper DFT allene-formation mechanism was retained with proton shuttling, ketoniminium/1-alkynylcadmium generation, propargylamine formation, [1,5] hydride shift, beta-elimination, and allene release. The unsuccessful attempt to locate a direct proton-transfer transition state is preserved.

unresolved: Compact organocadmium intermediates and allene 3a remain label-only/unverified.
No experimental quantities, workup, purification, or isolated yield are present on this page.

regions.region: page 4 left-column completion of Figure 2 discussion
regions.finding: Completes calculated [1,5] hydride migration (21.3 kcal mol^-1), beta-elimination (11.7 kcal mol^-1), and product release (+8.7 kcal mol^-1). These are mechanistic energies, not experimental outcomes.

Scheme 3 is the generic summary of the Figure 1/Figure 2 mechanism and is linked to the same two records; it does not create another reaction. Hydroamination through TS1_1 is identified as the overall rate-determining step.

Recorded Gaussian 09, B3LYP geometry optimization, basis sets, frequency/IRC checks, M06/SDD-6-311+G(d,p) single points, SMD toluene, and Gibbs free energies at 298 K. Propyne 1a (R = Me) is the stated working model.
